scripts.dev:mobile-shell: pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/observability' build && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/kernel' build && echo 'Mobile shell: http://localhost:3000/?launch=__terminal__' && (MATRIX_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV=1 pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/gateway' dev & E2E_TEST_BYPASS=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TEST_BYPASS=1 pnpm --filter './shell' dev)
scripts.docker: bun run docker:prepare && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
scripts.docker:full: bun run docker:prepare && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full up
scripts.docker:all: bun run docker:prepare && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full --profile obs up
scripts.docker:multi: bun run docker:prepare && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full --profile multi up
scripts.docker:stop: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full --profile obs --profile multi stop
scripts.docker:shell: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -u matrixos dev sh
scripts.test: sh -c 'pnpm --filter @matrix-os/observability build && pnpm --filter @matrix-os/kernel build && pnpm --filter @matrix-os/integrations-mcp build && vitest run "$@"' --
scripts.test:golden-snapshots: bun run test -- --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism tests/platform/golden-snapshot-*.test.ts tests/platform/host-bundle-snapshot-workflow.test.ts tests/platform/host-bundle-route.test.ts tests/platform/r2-client.test.ts tests/platform/ci-workflows.test.ts tests/platform/customer-vps.test.ts tests/platform/customer-vps-cloud-init.test.ts tests/platform/customer-vps-hetzner.test.ts tests/platform/customer-vps-host-bundle.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: sh -c 'pnpm --filter @matrix-os/observability build && pnpm --filter @matrix-os/kernel build && pnpm --filter @matrix-os/integrations-mcp build && vitest run --coverage "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e: sh -c 'pnpm --filter @matrix-os/observability build && pnpm --filter @matrix-os/kernel build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts "$@"' --
scripts.typecheck:build-kernel: pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/observability' build && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/kernel' build && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/integrations-mcp' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:build-kernel && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/observability' exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/integrations-mcp' exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/gateway' exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/platform' exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.typecheck.json && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/proxy' exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter '@matrix-os/edge-router' exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter desktop run typecheck
